entities.summary: Ikenna Ugochukwu Iroegbu is an American-Nigerian basketball player for Openjobmetis Varese of the Italian Lega Basket Serie A (LBA). Iroegbu played college basketball for Washington State University and is a member of the Nigerian national team. Ikenna Iroegbu was a athletes & competitors from Sacramento (b. 1995-03-14, Sacramento). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
